thread:
support-ana: Acme (acct-ACME) reporting sudden p99 spike around 14:22 UTC on dedicated-usw2. Customers seeing embedding timeouts and 504s. Escalated — ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-4567
andrew: I'm oncall, pulling traces now. Dashboard shows p50 ~80ms, p95 ~450ms, p99 jumped to ~3.2s at 14:22. Correlates with last night's infra roll.
jamie: @andrew any host metrics? NVMe await / qdepth lookups?
lucas: We rolled NVIDIA driver 535.9 + CUDA 12.3 to dedicated-usw2 at 02:15 UTC in batch `batch-20250602-535`. Canary passed then full rollout. I'll pull the rollout logs.
maya: KV cache miss_rate spiked ~2% -> 14% at 14:22. If cache misses increase, more NVMe reads; could amplify host io.
andrew: Quick iostat snapshot from node-037 at 14:23 UTC:
```
Device            tps    kB_read/s    kB_wrtn/s    await
nvme0n1         120.5       1600.0       3400.0     23.4
nvme1n1         130.7       1400.0       3600.0     25.7
```
Also seeing repeated `nvme nvme0: queue full` entries in dmesg.
lucas: That matches a staging repro we saw when driver changed submission path / qpair handling. Hypothesis: driver 535 changed queue semantics -> more host CPU blocking & longer NVMe latencies under load.
ops-tilly: Customer impact: embedding requests timed out -> retries and higher costs. Support routed ACME to eu1-dedicated pool as temporary fallback.
jamie: Mitigation plan (short): 1) rollback driver on small subset (25%) in us-west2 2) route heavy embedding traffic to eu1 3) apply blkio throttling to reduce queue saturation 4) run repro runs to bisect driver change.
andrew: Rolled back driver on node-037 and node-041 at 14:45 UTC. Within 2 minutes p99 dropped to ~210ms. Rollback looks effective.
support-ana: Notified customer and updated the ticket with temporary routing details.
maya: Repro steps for infra folks: run `stress-ng --class io --timeout 120s` on target node while running our embedding micro-bench to reproduce the p99 spike with new driver. Observed consistent repro in staging.
lucas: Commands we ran during triage:
```
ssh root@node-037
journalctl -u redwood-agent -S "2025-06-02 14:00" | grep -i nvme
sudo iostat -x 1 10
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu --format=csv
sudo apt-get install --reinstall nvidia-driver-535.9
```
jamie: Action items: lucas to open PR adding driver rollback playbook + post-deploy nvme iostat alert; maya to add kvcache miss-rate alert and dashboard; andrew to run cluster-wide canary with synthetic load before next driver rollout. I'll draft the incident postmortem timeline.
andrew: Incident doc created and linked: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2025-0602. Also started rollback job.
deploy-bot: Auto: rollback job started: job-88123; nodes targeted: node-037,node-041
support-ana: Thanks all — marking mitigated for now, keeping thread open until postmortem and follow-ups complete.
